name: daily-test-lab
description: Zero-cost daily tests and mini games MVP

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run verify && npm run test:backup
scripts.test:rules: npm run test:rules:normal && npm run test:rules:lockdown
scripts.test:rules:lockdown: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project daily-test-lab-rules-test --config firebase.lockdown.json "node --test tests/firestore.lockdown.rules.test.mjs"
